days_meaning: each delivery day costs you this much cash

messages.text: I'm opening at 84 P with delivery on day 10. Send me a concrete counter with both a price and a day, and we can move quickly.
Hola. I like it, and I can pay 65 P, delivery day 0.
I can come down to 77 P with delivery on day 10. If an earlier day matters more to you, I could do a higher price on day 0 instead; tell me which you prefer and we can settle quickly.
I can do 95 P, delivery on day 0.
I can do 75 P with delivery on day 0. That's a real move from me, so let's close it now.
